sentences.text: Shri Prasun Maheshwari, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Sangam Jain, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.

At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this first bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Crime No.52/2021 registered at Police Station Porsa, District Morena (M.P.) for offence under Sections 272, 273, 420 of IPC, Sections 51, 57 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
Accordingly, this bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(RAJEEV KUMAR SHRIVASTAVA) JUDGE Shubhankar SHUBHANKAR MISHRA 2021.02.22 18:36:51 +05'30'
